name: Decorated Desert Camel
shortDescription: A regal camel adorned with an ornately carved festive saddle.
description: The pride of the desert, captured in wood. This camel wears a festive carved saddle rich with floral medallions and hanging tassels, echoing the caparisoned camels of Rajasthan's fairs and processions. A warm, characterful piece that celebrates the spirit of the region.

faqs.question: Is the saddle a separate piece?
faqs.answer: No, the saddle and tassels are carved as part of the same block for durability.

faqs.question: Is this product handmade?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is entirely hand-carved and hand-polished by skilled artisans.

faqs.question: Does the colour vary?
faqs.answer: As it is natural sheesham wood with no paint, tone and grain vary slightly from piece to piece.
